lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform with approximately 30-50 pixel intervals, narrowing slightly at the posterior transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 8th line segment from the anterior, exhibiting a Y-shaped split approximately 25% down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 1, 2, and 11 exhibit truncation, failing to reach the ventral midline; line 5 shows a significant pixel-level discontinuity in the mid-torso region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 4 distinct white spots localized on the lower posterior haunch with a high-density proximity of approximately 10-15 pixels between centers.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of three white spots observed across the upper hind limb, forming a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking on the facial bridge between the eyes; singular white patch visible on the mid-neck/throat region; white spot clusters visible on the carpal and tarsal joints.
